text: My granddaughter is 19 months old and her temperature is 39.5, which really frightened me. She has a pinky rash on her back but I pressed a glass on it and it went pale, it fades every time. She hasn't done a poo for three days either and she's very grumpy, pushing and grizzling about it. I'm scared I'm missing something. Her parents are away tonight and it's just me.
